summary: Helus Pharma Inc., a Canadian clinical-stage pharmaceutical registrant, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated October 8, 2026, announcing an investor presentation to be webcast October 21, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. EDT. The presentation covers HLP003, a proprietary serotonergic agonist in Phase 3 for adjunctive major depressive disorder with FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation, and HLP004 in Phase 2 for generalized anxiety disorder, plus key opinion leader commentary and a Q&A with executive leadership. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations scheduling notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies, and attention centers on any clinical or regulatory updates during the event.
